messages:
Sam: Quick alignment  we're planning a short post + benchmark snapshot Weds 14:00 UTC. Embargo until then. Draft: https://go.redwood/bench-snapshot.
Ivy: Copy. I'll queue embargo emails at 13:20 UTC and do an APAC follow-up at 13:50. Press list in the doc.
Jon: I'll own post-publish analytics and rapid replies. Can DataOps raise log retention & realtime dashboard retention for 3 hours? Need token-level spikes visible.
DataOps: On it. Increasing retention to 3h and provisioning a quick Grafana panel (seq latency, token/s, error-rate). Link will be posted here when ready.
Sam: Legal YI: partner quote included, legal cleared yesterday but please confirm no raw partner tables in public assets.
Legal: Confirmed. Remove raw partner tables; use summary line only.
press-bot: Reminder scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 13:20 UTC (in ~40m).
Ivy: Social copy drafted but holding until hero image final. Design promised final at 13:05.
Jon: Analytics note: I'll create two alerts: 1) latency > 2x median for > 2m, 2) error-rate > 1% sustained. Will post escalation instructions in the panel.
Sam: Good. Manual publish snippet if needed:
```
# manual publish
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" -d '{"slug":"bench-snapshot-wk23"}'
```
Ivy: Press outreach plan: top-tier + dedicated reporter calls. Add a line in embargo email offering live demo access for reporters who ask.
Sam: Agreed. Jon, who are the on-the-record engineers?
Jon: Lina (infra) and Omar (runtime). They'll be available 13:30-15:00 UTC. Backup: Priya.
DataOps: Grafana panel up at https://grafana.redwood/d/bench/launch, retention set, alerts configured.
press-bot: Scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 13:20 UTC.
Ivy: All set from my side. React with :thumbsup: when your items are done.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Jon: :thumbsup: monitoring ready
DataOps: :thumbsup: dashboards up
Legal: :thumbsup: wording cleared
Sam: Great. I'll do a dry run at 13:55 UTC and lift embargo at 14:00. If anything urgent appears, open #release-control.
